[SWS_DM_02130] Access control on ara::diag interfaces
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall restrict the processes that can interact
over any ara::diag interface only to the processes referenced by the corresponding
mapping in the role process in the manifest. Restriction means that no interaction
